paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and enhanced mechanical behavior of the Al7Co24Cr21Fe24Ni24 high-entropy alloy system by tuning the Cr content

evidence.quote: the (Al 7Co24Cr21Fe24Ni24)100-xCrx (x = 0, 11, 20, and 26) high entropy alloys were prepared and investigated.

evidence.section: 3.1. Structural evolution as a function of the Cr concentration
evidence.quote: For the Cr0 alloy, only a single FCC crystal structure is observed.

evidence.section: 3.1. Structural evolution as a function of the Cr concentration
evidence.quote: Apparently, there is a crystal structure transition from single FCC to FCC plus BCC phases with increasing the Cr content.

evidence.section: 3.1. Structural evolution as a function of the Cr concentration
evidence.quote: when the addition of Cr is 11 at%, the (1 1 0) BCC peak near the (1 1 1) FCC peak begins to appear in the alloy.
